items.title: Strengthening our safety ecosystem with external testing
items.summary: OpenAI works with independent experts to evaluate frontier AI systems. Third-party testing strengthens safety, validates safeguards, and increases transparency in how we assess model capabilities and risks.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI宣布加强其安全生态系统，通过与独立外部专家合作，对前沿AI系统进行严格评估。此举旨在通过第三方验证机制，强化模型安全防护措施，并提升模型能力与风险评估的透明度。这种外部审计模式是当前AI行业治理的重要方向，有助于建立更具公信力的安全评估标准。

items.title: OpenAI and Target team up on new AI-powered experiences
items.summary: OpenAI and Target are partnering to bring a new Target app to ChatGPT, offering personalized shopping and faster checkout. Target will also expand its use of ChatGPT Enterprise to boost productivity and guest experiences.

items.title: Building more with GPT-5.1-Codex-Max
items.summary: Introducing GPT-5.1-Codex-Max, a faster, more intelligent agentic coding model for Codex. The model is designed for long-running, project-scale work with enhanced reasoning and token efficiency.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI推出了GPT-5.1-Codex-Max，这是一款专为复杂代码开发任务设计的智能体模型。该模型针对长周期、项目级的编程工作进行了深度优化，通过增强的推理能力和更高的Token处理效率，旨在提升开发者的生产力。作为Codex系列的最新迭代，它不仅在代码生成准确性上有所突破，还特别强化了对复杂逻辑的理解，能够更好地处理大规模代码库的维护与构建任务，是当前AI辅助编程领域的重要进展。

items.title: GPT-5.1-Codex-Max System Card
items.summary: This system card outlines the comprehensive safety measures implemented for GPT‑5.1-CodexMax. It details both model-level mitigations, such as specialized safety training for harmful tasks and prompt injections, and product-level mitigations like agent sandboxing and configurable network access.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布了GPT-5.1-Codex-Max的系统卡片，详细阐述了针对该模型的安全保障措施。内容涵盖了模型层面的专项训练（如防范提示词注入和有害任务处理）以及产品层面的防御手段，特别是引入了智能体沙箱（Agent Sandboxing）和可配置的网络访问控制。这些措施旨在确保智能体在执行自动化编程任务时，能够有效隔离风险并防止恶意操作，为企业级AI应用提供了安全基准。
